Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal for next meeting: technical deep-dive with engineering + infra to validate latency SLOs, integration points, and security checklist items.

Proposed 60-minute technical deep-dive windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tuesday, Apr 12, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Option B: Wednesday, Apr 13, 1:30–2:30 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works best or suggest two alternatives? Also please confirm the engineering attendees (names + roles) we should invite so we include the right Redwood folks.

I've attached a very short draft agenda ("draft-agenda.pdf") to help structure the session and included a mutual action plan stub in the Drive link below. If you prefer Google Meet instead of Zoom, say the word and we'll switch.

Next actions once we lock time: I or Camila will send a calendar invite (Zoom + ICS) and a walkthrough doc for the infra prerequisites.

Thanks,
